Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Season 15 launch-week build on live patch 3.2.1 (live since 2026-09-15; Hotfix 1 changed no balance). This is a published Maxroll build, not an invention: Maxroll rates Storm Strike A on its endgame list (the second Druid, behind Lacerate), A on push and A on speedfarm. Neither d4builds nor InfinityBuilds lists it, so on the owner's weighting (d4builds > InfinityBuilds > Maxroll) it carries the least weighted evidence of the three Druid builds. The theorycraft label here means 'untested by this site and unsupported by the higher-weighted references', not 'unpublished'. The engine: Storm Strike chains lightning off a Werewolf-tagged basic attack, with Shard of Verathiel, Ifeh's Dire Totem, Dark Howl, Dirge of Airidah and Airidah's Inexorable Will (3.2.1: 30–45%[x], up from 7–10%[x]) and five Storm Shepherd charms plus The Furnace. Grizzly Rage bakes in Cornered Beast at up to 150%[x] on 3.2.1 and the Willpower scalar is 1.625%. Two cautions: Storm Shepherd's Call was redesigned in 3.2.1 as a nerf by Blizzard's own account, and Maxroll re-saved its planner on 2026-09-16 21:01 after the reference sweep read it (Endgame bar and amulet changed) — the stages below are the specialist's decode of that later save. Maxroll publishes no push profile, so pushing repeats the Endgame profile. Soul Splinters: Leoric's Crown carries Anguish + Pain (no Hellfire), consistent with this build's crit gear, plus Sin and the Black Soulstone in jewelry — five in all against the season article's 'up to three' among Jewelry slots; the true cap with Leoric's Crown is unpublished, re-verify.

Rotation
  1. Keep Lightning Storm and Grizzly Rage up, refresh Debilitating Roar, drop Poison Creeper, and attack with Storm Strike.
Variants

Leveling — Keep Lightning Storm up, drop Cataclysm and Poison Creeper on packs, attack with Storm Strike. (Specialist distillation of Maxroll's bar; the guide's rotation text is not in the knowledge base — re-verify against the guide.)
Move on when Move on when you have Leoric's Crown, Shard of Verathiel, Ifeh's Dire Totem, Dark Howl and five Storm Shepherd charms (Midgame profile).

Early Endgame — Keep Lightning Storm and Grizzly Rage up, refresh Debilitating Roar, drop Poison Creeper, and attack with Storm Strike. (Specialist distillation of Maxroll's bar; the guide's rotation text is not in the knowledge base — re-verify against the guide.)
Move on when Swap to the Endgame layout when Leoric's Crown, Shard of Verathiel, Ifeh's Dire Totem, Dark Howl, Tibault's Will, Dirge of Airidah and Airidah's Inexorable Will are Mythic and you own The Furnace as a sixth charm.

Late Endgame — Keep Lightning Storm and Grizzly Rage up, refresh Debilitating Roar, drop Poison Creeper, and attack with Storm Strike. (Specialist distillation of Maxroll's bar; the guide's rotation text is not in the knowledge base — re-verify against the guide.)
Move on when Push when every item above is Mythic and Masterworked; no separate push loadout exists — watch survivability first (see test notes).

Pushing — Keep Lightning Storm and Grizzly Rage up, refresh Debilitating Roar, drop Poison Creeper, and attack with Storm Strike. (Specialist distillation of Maxroll's bar; the guide's rotation text is not in the knowledge base — re-verify against the guide.)

Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Season 15 launch-week build on live patch 3.2.1 (live since 2026-09-15; Hotfix 1 changed no balance). This is a published Maxroll build, not an invention: Maxroll rates Storm Strike A on its endgame list (the second Druid, behind Lacerate), A on push and A on speedfarm. Neither d4builds nor InfinityBuilds lists it, so on the owner's weighting (d4builds > InfinityBuilds > Maxroll) it carries the least weighted evidence of the three Druid builds. The theorycraft label here means 'untested by this site and unsupported by the higher-weighted references', not 'unpublished'. The engine: Storm Strike chains lightning off a Werewolf-tagged basic attack, with Shard of Verathiel, Ifeh's Dire Totem, Dark Howl, Dirge of Airidah and Airidah's Inexorable Will (3.2.1: 30–45%[x], up from 7–10%[x]) and five Storm Shepherd charms plus The Furnace. Grizzly Rage bakes in Cornered Beast at up to 150%[x] on 3.2.1 and the Willpower scalar is 1.625%. Two cautions: Storm Shepherd's Call was redesigned in 3.2.1 as a nerf by Blizzard's own account, and Maxroll re-saved its planner on 2026-09-16 21:01 after the reference sweep read it (Endgame bar and amulet changed) — the stages below are the specialist's decode of that later save. Maxroll publishes no push profile, so pushing repeats the Endgame profile. Soul Splinters: Leoric's Crown carries Anguish + Pain (no Hellfire), consistent with this build's crit gear, plus Sin and the Black Soulstone in jewelry — five in all against the season article's 'up to three' among Jewelry slots; the true cap with Leoric's Crown is unpublished, re-verify.

Rotation
  1. Keep Lightning Storm and Grizzly Rage up, refresh Debilitating Roar, drop Poison Creeper, and attack with Storm Strike.
Variants

Leveling — Keep Lightning Storm up, drop Cataclysm and Poison Creeper on packs, attack with Storm Strike. (Specialist distillation of Maxroll's bar; the guide's rotation text is not in the knowledge base — re-verify against the guide.)
Move on when Move on when you have Leoric's Crown, Shard of Verathiel, Ifeh's Dire Totem, Dark Howl and five Storm Shepherd charms (Midgame profile).

Early Endgame — Keep Lightning Storm and Grizzly Rage up, refresh Debilitating Roar, drop Poison Creeper, and attack with Storm Strike. (Specialist distillation of Maxroll's bar; the guide's rotation text is not in the knowledge base — re-verify against the guide.)
Move on when Swap to the Endgame layout when Leoric's Crown, Shard of Verathiel, Ifeh's Dire Totem, Dark Howl, Tibault's Will, Dirge of Airidah and Airidah's Inexorable Will are Mythic and you own The Furnace as a sixth charm.

Late Endgame — Keep Lightning Storm and Grizzly Rage up, refresh Debilitating Roar, drop Poison Creeper, and attack with Storm Strike. (Specialist distillation of Maxroll's bar; the guide's rotation text is not in the knowledge base — re-verify against the guide.)

Reasoning

HypothesisStorm Strike should carry a Druid through endgame and push on 3.2.1 because Airidah's Inexorable Will rose from 7–10%[x] to 30–45%[x], Grizzly Rage now bakes in Cornered Beast at up to 150%[x], and the Willpower scalar is 1.625% — and Maxroll's Season 15 planner turns those into a Storm Strike build with Shard of Verathiel, Ifeh's Dire Totem, Dark Howl, Dirge of Airidah and five Storm Shepherd charms. Maxroll rates it A on endgame (second Druid), push and speedfarm; neither d4builds nor InfinityBuilds lists it, so on the owner's weighting it is the least-evidenced of the three Druid builds and is carried here as the untested slot.
Confidencemedium
How to test itUntested by this site. (1) Confirm on the live tooltip that Airidah's Inexorable Will reads 30–45%[x]. (2) Storm Shepherd's Call was redesigned in 3.2.1 as a nerf by Blizzard's own account (2-piece 0.25% per Spirit consumed, capped at 80%, one refreshable stack; 5-piece +100%[x]); Storm Strike is a Basic skill and consumes no Spirit — verify whether the 2-piece does anything for this build before valuing the set, or whether the set's 5-piece alone justifies it. (3) Maxroll's planner was re-saved 2026-09-16 21:01 after the reference sweep read it: its Endgame bar changed from Ravens + Hurricane to Wolves + Poison Creeper and its amulet from Locran's Talisman (Overcharged) to a Crushing Aspect legendary — re-read the guide text before trusting either. (4) Maxroll publishes no push profile; test Endgame gear in the Pit before assuming it scales. (5) Compare against the Landslide meta at equal gear on the same Pit tier.
